title: 第195章传说中的仙界第194章心境裂缝
slug: 修仙回来后我儿孙满堂了
content_zh:
第195章传说中的仙界
在郁凡忐忑不安之际，事实上下界的状况非常稳定。
第一个修为达到渡劫期的并非是郁家人，而是郁凡的大弟子陈子轩。
可是陈子轩并没有想要飞升的想法。
他父亲曾建业如今也，只是堪堪达到金丹期而已，而他的妻子更是停留在了筑基期，虽然孩子的天赋非常的高，但也不过是在金丹后期而已。
他自觉自己不能够抛弃自己的家人，而自己飞升。
于是便停留在了蓝星，继续在天衍宗做一个大长老。
更何况虽然目前蓝星没有其他的仙界之人来攻击，但他担心会有曾经在蓝星被打劫过的人过来复仇。
他觉得与其自己飞升，不如在这里守护住蓝星，等待着他的家人一起飞升。
而第二个达到渡劫期的郁景也是同样的想法。
爷爷已经飞升了，他相信自家爷爷在仙界是绝对不会有问题的，然而自己的弟妹却需要他的督促。
他相信，若是没有自己看着他们，弟弟必然会沉迷于阵法之中无可自拔，而他妹妹则是沉迷在情爱中，更是不会将心思放在修炼之中。
而他不靠谱的老爹如今成了天衍宗的宗主，每天都只想着怎么将宗门打造的更好，压根就没有过要飞升的念头。
因为种种原因，反而是郁凡被抛弃在了仙界。
郁凡没有想到自己在仙界苦苦的等待着子孙们上来，而子孙们并没有想要飞升仙界的想法。
在他们看来凡尘俗世虽然俗，但是却也是非常有趣的，在他们的印象中，仙界是一个非常刻板的地方，若是真正的到了仙界，可能会被限制住很多事情。
飞升可以，但顺其自然吧。
郁凡不断的想着，若是下界出了事情，自己不在可怎么办？
随后又想到了自己的徒弟们及孩子们，以他们的实力来说不应该在自己走后会出事啊？
越想越不安心的郁凡，决定自己下界亲自看看。

作为仙帝的郁凡，早就早已经有了打开空间裂缝的能力，只是他从未想过自己要下去看看而已。
于是他直接撕裂了空间，从空间缝隙中走到了宇宙中。
由于空间缝隙进入的地方是随机性的，所以他也不清楚自己在宇宙的哪个地方。
但好在从蓝星出来的只会在属于蓝星的这个星系里，至少他曾经有过遨游宇宙的经验，对于他来说倒算是熟门熟路了。
站在蓝星外，便看到蓝星那浓厚的仙气将整个蓝星笼罩了起来。
看来蓝心的灵气倒是越发浓郁了。
正当他想进入蓝星之时，才发现自己居然被天道所阻止。
很显然，以自己仙帝的修为是无法进入到蓝星的。
想到曾经自己坑别人的方式，郁凡不由的抽了抽嘴角。
仙帝修为的自己进入蓝星只怕只有化神期的修为了。
叹了一口气，郁凡压制住自己的修为进入蓝星。
然而在蓝星随意的游转了一圈，并没有发现任何异常。
他看到了自家的孩子们有认真修炼的，当然也有在偷懒的，更看到了自家儿子只沉迷于将天衍宗进入商业化的模式中。

Chapter 195 The legendary fairyland
While Yu Fan was uneasy, the situation in the lower realm was actually very stable.
The first person to reach the stage of transcending tribulation was not the Yu family, but Yu Fan's eldest disciple Chen Zixuan.
But Chen Zixuan has no intention of ascending.
His father, Zeng Jianye, has barely reached the Golden Core stage, while his wife is still in the Foundation Establishment stage. Although the child's talent is very high, it is only in the late Golden Core stage.
He felt that he could not abandon his family and ascend on his own.
So he stayed in Blue Star and continued to be a great elder in Tianyan Sect.
What's more, although there are currently no other people from the immortal world attacking Blue Star, he is worried that people who have been robbed in Blue Star will come to take revenge.
He felt that instead of ascending by himself, it would be better to protect Blue Star here and wait for his family to ascend together.
Yu Jing, the second person to reach the stage of transcending tribulation, had the same idea.
Grandpa has ascended. He believes that his grandfather will never have any problems in the fairy world. However, his younger siblings need his supervision.
He believed that if he didn't watch them, his younger brother would be addicted to the formation and unable to extricate himself, while his sister would be addicted to love and would not focus on cultivation.
And his unreliable father has now become the sect leader of Tianyan Sect. He only thinks about how to make the sect better every day, and has no thought of ascending at all.
Due to various reasons, Yu Fan was abandoned in the fairy world.
Yu Fan did not expect that he would be waiting for his descendants to come up in the fairy world, but his descendants had no intention of ascending to the fairy world.
In their opinion, although the mortal world is vulgar, it is also very interesting. In their impression, the fairy world is a very rigid place. If you really go to the fairy world, you may be restricted from many things.
Ascension is fine, but let nature take its course.
Yu Fan kept thinking, what if something happened in the lower realm and he was not around?
Then he thought about his disciples and children. With their strength, shouldn't something happen to them after he left?
The more he thought about it, the more uneasy he became, and Yu Fan decided to go down to see for himself.
As the Immortal Emperor, Yu Fan has already had the ability to open space cracks, but he never thought that he would go down and take a look.
So he directly tore apart the space and walked from the gap in space into the universe.
Since the place where the space gap enters is random, he doesn't know where he is in the universe.
But fortunately, those who come out of Blue Star will only be in the galaxy belonging to Blue Star. At least he has had the experience of traveling in the universe, which is quite familiar to him.
Standing outside Blue Star, you can see Blue Star's thick fairy energy enveloping the entire Blue Star.
It seems that Lan Xin's aura is getting stronger.
Just when he wanted to enter Blue Star, he found that he was actually blocked by the way of heaven.
Obviously, with his Immortal Emperor's cultivation, he cannot enter Blue Star.
Thinking of the ways he had deceived others, Yu Fan couldn't help but twitch the corner of his mouth.
As an Immortal Emperor, I am afraid that I can only enter the Blue Star if I am in the Divine Transformation Stage.
With a sigh, Yu Fan suppressed his cultivation and entered Blue Star.
However, after casually wandering around Blue Star, I didn't find anything unusual.
He saw that some of his children were practicing seriously, and of course some were lazy. He also saw that his son was only obsessed with commercializing the Tianyan Sect.
